findings.description: AWS access key and secret key are hardcoded in plaintext as Lambda environment variables, exposing long-lived credentials to anyone with read access to the Lambda configuration or Terraform state, and risking leakage via version control.

The Lambda function does not specify a KMS key (kms_key_arn) for encrypting environment variables at rest, leaving sensitive data protected only by default AWS-managed keys instead of customer-managed encryption, compounding the risk of the exposed secrets.
